node.statement: Correct the quotient-norm step as follows. Let V=i*reals*J and let q:icalH->icalH/V be the quotient map. Since R|_V=0, the induced map Rbar is well-defined by Rbar(q(x))=q(Rx). Hence, for every x in icalH and every v in V, Rbar(q(x))=q(R(x+v)), and therefore ||Rbar(q(x))||_quot=||q(R(x+v))||_quot<=||R(x+v)||<=||R||*||x+v||. Taking the infimum over v in V gives ||Rbar(q(x))||_quot<=||R||*||q(x)||_quot, so ||Rbar||<=||R||. Here R=DF_+(0)+I=D(F_+-id)(0)+2I, and (A_7) together with (R) gives ||R||<=C_der*(epsilon_r+r_iso)<=kappa_der/4<1. Thus ||D-breve-sigma_{breve-e}+I||=||Rbar||<1. No equality between the quotient norm of q(Rx) and the ambient norm of Rx is used.
